accessBasis.gate: Each register resolves its own CreateAccessService.resolveRegisterCreateAccess — VoucherRegisterType.creditNote with registerDisplayName 'Credit Notes', and .debitNote with 'Debit Notes'. The two are independently granted, which is why the guide says so explicitly.

behaviourReviewed: Both forms are two-tab: Particulars (one ledger account plus an amount) and Items (stock lines with quantity and rate). Save validates the active tab.

The credit note carries an 'Against invoice (optional)' card that opens SelectInvoicesScreen in singleSelect mode under the title 'Against invoice'; the chosen invoice is stored as original_invoice_id and the loader turns it into an Agst Ref in Tally (source comment at create_credit_note_screen.dart:365-366).
The debit note has NO against-invoice card — verified by absence in create_debit_note_screen.dart; its reason lives in the narration.

Empty states differ: the credit note's items tab reads 'No items added' / 'Tap below to add items from your inventory'; the debit note's reads 'No items added yet'. The Items action is 'Add More Items' on the credit note and 'Modify Items' on the debit note.
Validation messages are shared: Please add at least one item / Please select a ledger account / Ledger amount must be greater than 0 / Total amount must be greater than 0.
Registers are separate screens with their own month scope and their own search hints (by customer vs by supplier).
